name: Keese
description: A bat-like enemy that flies around.

fields.name: Keese Type
fields.description: Determines the movement behavior of the Keese.

0.name: Default
0.description: Remains stationary until the player approaches, then slowly flies toward them.

3.name: Flies Up and Down
3.description: Flies up and down and approaches the player when nearby.

4.name: Independent Movement
4.description: Moves independently without the normal player-seeking behavior.

fields.name: Upside Down
fields.description: Turns the Keese upside down, making it appear to hang from the ceiling.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: Specifies the local variable used to control the Keese's activation.
